rows.title: Illicit whisky
rows.evidence: The Pabbay, Harris article says this Pabbay lies in the Sound of Harris between Harris and North Uist and exported illicit whisky, which matches atlas island osm-way-4596121 (57.77, -7.23) and not the Pabbay south of Barra.
rows.summary: Pabbay (Scottish Gaelic: Pabaigh) is an uninhabited island in the Outer Hebrides of Scotland which lies in the Sound of Harris between Harris and North Uist. The island was once very fertile, supporting a three-figure population and exporting corn, barley and illicit whisky.
